name: Stock locations
history: Every book has a permanent default warehouse; movements recorded before this module carry it implicitly. Additional warehouses and vans, per-location carrying values and transfers at carrying value require the enabled module. 1.2 adds warehouse kinds (a van is a mobile location with a driver), numbered stock documents — stock issue, re-issue, return from van and gate passes — over the same movements, the van settlement review, and the stock-by-location report. Historical movements, documents and reports stay readable when it is disabled; only new writes are refused. The number series live in Admin > Numbering and are listed here as settings.
